description: This file defines a class DetailsToExpand responsible for converting specific XML/HTML content, particularly handling custom tags, CDATA sections, and converting 'details' elements into a structured macro format within Confluence markup.

classes.name: DetailsToExpand
classes.description: A utility class for converting and transforming Confluence-related HTML/XML content, especially expanding 'details' macros into a structured format.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts input HTML/XML content by escaping namespace tags, extracting CDATA, parsing and transforming 'details' elements, and restoring original content.

methods.name: findSummary
methods.description: Finds the 'summary' child element within a given DOM element.

methods.name: isWithinCodeBlock
methods.description: Checks if a given DOM element is within a code macro block to avoid processing such elements.

methods.name: convertOne
methods.description: Transforms a 'details' macro element into an 'expand' macro with a title and body, suitable for Confluence markup.
